Messages.Author: ORi
Messages.Body:
I'm sure it must have been answered before but I can't find it.

Situation:
Vamp A, B, C Blood Brothers from the same circle (with SAN), vamp A is
in combat.

Can vamps B, C both play Octopod to give vamp A 4 additional strikes?

As stated in rulebook, "A minion cannot use more than one card or
effect to gain additional strikes per round of combat." but since they
are different minions who play Octopod, is it legal? is it considered
both Octopods as the same effect?

tx, ORi

Messages.Body:
> No.
> See http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/BLbbr.html

Can the vamp in combat use Octopod? Or does it have to be
a vamp outside of combat? I'm confused because it says both:

"Requires a Blood Brother of the same circle as another one
in combat"

but then it also says

"Can be used by a vampire even if he or she is not involved in
the combat."

_Can be used...even if not involved_... That makes me think
that the vamp in combat can use it. But then the first sentance
makes me think that it can't.
Please clarify?

Sorrow

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <u6sqmtj...@corp.supernews.com>, Sorrow <cbo...@apdi.net>
writes:

>"Requires a Blood Brother of the same circle as another one
>in combat"
>
>but then it also says
>
>"Can be used by a vampire even if he or she is not involved in
>the combat."
>
>_Can be used...even if not involved_... That makes me think
>that the vamp in combat can use it. But then the first sentance
>makes me think that it can't.
>Please clarify?

The second sentence clarifies that it can be played without being in
combat - which you would normally need.

And it *could* be played by an opposing vampire. Chicago BB vs Chicago
BB, say.

But it can't be played by the recipient - since he is not "another"
vampire.
